name: Furnace of the Evening Glow (Mộ Quang Lô)
lore: A squat clay censer-furnace fired at Hôi Diêu Thôn's lime kilns, the one Tào Mộ Tử carried down from the steppe in 1187 with the coals still in it, so that the pavilion's fire never went out across the move (N-yen_quang-03). He made Hình Lạc Nhạn's tincture in it.
build_use: The head's healing furnace: slow at first, strong after twenty seconds.

name: The Cold Furnace (Lãnh Lô)
lore: The bronze furnace in which Diêm Tử Tô made the founder's breakthrough pill in 1150 (N-yen_quang-02). He has not lit it since. He keeps it on the Dusk Field beside her grave and polishes it every evening.
build_use: The grand elder's furnace: large modifiers, and one lighting he refuses to use.

name: Gourd of the Last Light (Tàn Quang Hồ Lô)
lore: A bottle gourd from Hoa Khê Thôn, lacquered inside with the founder's resin, that keeps an herb picked in the evening glow as fresh as the hour it was cut for a year. Văn Đương Quy has carried it on the Dusk Field for sixty years.
build_use: The picker's gourd: healing and linh lực sustain.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Camellia Seed Pendant (Sơn Trà Bội)
lore: A camellia seed from Sơn Trà Thôn set in a ring of bone. Vi Ngưng Yên gave it to him in 1065 and asked for it back if he ever lit the furnace for anyone else.

name: Robe of the Dusk Field (Mộ Điền Bào)
lore: Earth-brown robe stained with fifty years of the Dusk Field's soil. He has knelt by her grave in it every evening since 1150.
build_use: Staying power for the long, patient fight.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Gourd of the Purple Haze (Tử Yên Hồ Lô)
lore: A small gourd from the founder's own vine, stoppered with the cloth he was left in at the steppe gate; it holds a breath of the evening haze for a day. Vi Ngưng Yên gave it to him at his foundation.
build_use: Heals over time and poison kept out: he does not fall.
